root_cause: The dGPU LLM accuracy test job calls optimum-intel's OVModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained, which in turn calls huggingface_hub's list_repo_tree/list_repo_files API to enumerate model files for Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct before downloading. The shared CI HuggingFace Hub API token/IP has exhausted its quota of 3000 API requests per 5-minute window (team plan), causing the Hub to return HTTP 429. This is an external service (HuggingFace Hub) rate limit, not a code or configuration defect in openvino.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally since it depends on the CI runner's shared HF Hub quota state at the time of the run. To reproduce the symptom: run `pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py::test_accuracy_conformance -k Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct` repeatedly in rapid succession (or with many parallel CI jobs sharing the same HF token) until the Hub's 3000 req/5min quota is exhausted; the same HfHubHTTPError 429 will surface.
recommended_actions: Add automatic retry-with-backoff around HuggingFace Hub metadata/download calls in tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py (huggingface_hub supports a built-in retry via HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_RETRIES or wrapping from_pretrained in tenacity-style retry on HfHubHTTPError 429).

Use a local/mirrored model cache (pre-downloaded artifact or self-hosted HF cache proxy) for Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct and other frequently-used LLM accuracy test models to avoid hitting the Hub API on every run.

Check whether multiple concurrent post-commit/merge-queue runs share the same HF_TOKEN and are collectively exceeding the 3000 req/5min quota; consider per-job tokens or spacing out LLM accuracy jobs.
Re-run the failed job; this is a transient external rate limit, not expected to recur immediately once the quota window resets.
prevention_strategies: Cache HuggingFace models (either via a shared read-through proxy/mirror inside the CI network, or via actions/cache keyed on model revision) so that `list_repo_files`/`list_repo_tree` and blob downloads are not re-issued against the public Hub API for every job run. Wrap Hub API calls used in LLM accuracy tests with exponential backoff retry on 429 responses, respecting the `Retry-After` header returned by the Hub.
historical_context: No prior pattern recorded for this HuggingFace Hub 429 rate-limit signature in the post-commit knowledge base; this is the first occurrence. Other LLM/model-hub related entries recorded previously (e.g., PyTorch model hub HF Transformers NumPy version mismatch) are unrelated dependency issues, not Hub API rate limiting.
